standard_prerequisites.name: The property of dualizing complexes that identifies the double dual of the structure sheaf with the other dualizing complex up to an invertible object
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 2928-2930)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the invertible object that the statement predicts.

standard_prerequisites.name: The technical hom-evaluation isomorphism for complexes of finite tor dimension
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2936-2939)
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the invertibility into the tensor description of the internal hom between the two dualizing complexes.

core_obligations: Produce the invertible object: the functor sending a complex to the internal hom of its dual with respect to the second dualizing complex takes the structure sheaf to an invertible object, giving an isomorphism from that object into the internal hom between the two dualizing complexes (proof lines 2928-2935)

Use finite tor dimension: because that object has finite tor dimension, the technical hom-evaluation statement identifies the tensor product of the internal hom between the two complexes with the composite functor on bounded coherent complexes (proof lines 2936-2945)
Evaluate: setting the argument to be the first dualizing complex turns the identification into the quasi-isomorphism asserted by the statement (proof lines 2946)
proof_roadmap: 由 dualizing 与 equivalence-comes-from-invertible：K ↦ RHom(RHom(K,ω),ω') 把 A 送到可逆对象 L，即 L ≅ RHom(ω, ω')。
L 有有限 tor 维数 ⇒ 用 More on Algebra 的 hom-evaluation 技术引理：RHom(ω,ω') ⊗^L K → RHom(RHom(K,ω), ω') 对 K ∈ D^b_Coh(A) 同构。
取 K = ω 即得 ω' ≅ ω ⊗^L L，正是所断言的拟同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that any two dualizing complexes on a Noetherian ring differ by the derived tensor product with an invertible object (author lemma at source lines 2918-2925, label lemma-dualizing-unique). The proof (source lines 2927-2947) applies the earlier description of equivalences to obtain an invertible object isomorphic to the internal hom from one dualizing complex into the other, uses the finite tor dimension of that object to invoke the hom-evaluation isomorphism on bounded coherent complexes, and evaluates at the first dualizing complex to read off the asserted quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 2928-2946). The construction of the invertible object and the evaluation step are the substance. H3.
